page.notes: Greek entries in column 1 and column 2 (e.g. the Greek headwords after "Papismus", "Parentum", "Pastores" and "Patrum") are not legible enough to copy, so they are marked illegible with approximate letter counts. Column 1 "Papismus" headword has a Greek gloss beside it. The entry "Paulus an in incertum cucur-" continues as "rerit 47.a" at the top of column 3. The final line "Paulus nō senioribus tantū sed" is cut off at the foot and continues on the next page. Catchword "sed" and signature "R 2" read with some doubt. Lines with 'Papismus' Greek and "ωαναλης" are illegible. Printed numbers such as "4.0.a" and "1.a" are copied as they appear on the scan.
